messages:
anya: Quick sync — I pushed a short RFC draft for Smart Routing / Fallback focused on SLA-aware tiering. Link: https://redwood/repo/rfcs/1765432100. TL;DR: three-level fallback (region-preferred → cross-region → low-cost variant), plus per-tenant policy overrides. Need prioritization for M1 roadmap, acceptance criteria, and edge-case list. Who can take the compatibility matrix?

matt: skimmed the draft, looks reasonable. imperative we pick an MVP scope: customers keep asking for region pinning + cost fallback. propose MVP: region preference + single-step fallback to approved variant in same region. postpone cross-region until after canary.

kevin: +1 on narrowing MVP. also: we need explicit launch criteria tied to SLOs, not just "works". suggested acceptance criteria snippet I added in comments: 
```
- Functional: requests honor per-tenant region preference header (X-Region-Pref) 100%
- Latency: P95 end-to-end add < 25ms overhead vs current baseline for routed requests
- Correctness: fallback never serves model variant with incompatible tokenizer/format
- Observability: per-route traces + metric (fallback_count) emitted
```

olivia: edge cases we ran into with earlier rollouts: model-variant incompatibility (e.g., vocab length mismatch), tokenization drift, and cached KV invalidation. add these to RFC. Also: need runway for canary rollback within 5 minutes.

anya: good list. adding launch criteria we care about: customer acceptance test (done by SE team), perf lab synthetic run (10k reqs/min), and at least 2 paying customers on dedicated who sign off. Thoughts on ordering?

lauren: from product: prioritize tenant controls first (ability to opt-out of fallback or set cost cap). Sales said "region pinning" is top ask but larger customers insist on opt-out + audit log for any fallback. So include audit trail acceptance criteria: every automated fallback must create an audit event with reason, original target, final variant.

kevin: noted. for compatibility matrix — I can assemble a first pass mapping models -> compatible variants + tokenizer + quantization knobs. need input from runtime team on kernel/sequence limits. can we get that by EOD Fri?

anya: assigning kevin for matrix. @sre-bot can you run a quick query for recent incidents where cross-region fallback could have avoided client errors? want to quantify impact for prioritization.

sre-bot: Report queued. Found 7 incidents in last 90d where region outages caused >1% error rate for affected tenants. Attaching summary in thread.

matt: thanks. that data helps justify cross-region later. for MVP doc we'll scope to same-region fallbacks only, but keep a clear extension path for cross-region (appendix + compatibility constraints). also include rollout plan: canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error spikes (>0.5% increase) or latency regressions (P95 +15%).

olivia: don't forget caching implications: prefix cache keys must include fallback variant id to avoid returning wrong cached outputs. add explicit acceptance test for cache separation.

anya: love it — I'll update RFC: mark MVP scope, add the acceptance criteria block, rollout steps, audit/event schema example, and list of edge cases. final ask: reviewers please leave +1 or concerns by EOD tomorrow so we can convert to PRD. :thumbsup:
